en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban, from Abu Is’haq Ibrahim Al Sayqal who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘A parchment was found to be in a handle of a sword of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> in which was (inscribed): ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Beneficent, the Merciful.

The most troublesome of the people to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic on the Day of Judgement would be the one who killed someone other than his (attempted) killer, and the striker of someone other than the one who struck him, and the one who befriended other than his friends, so he is a disbeliever with what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>. And the one who initiates an event (killing), or shelters an initiator, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would not Accept from him on the Day of Judgement, neither any exchange nor a ransom’.

(He - the narrator) said, ‘Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Do you know what is the meaning of the who befriends other than his friends?’ I said, ‘What is the meaning of it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It means the people of the Religion’.
And the ‘exchange’ is the repentance in the words of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and the ‘ransom’ is the sacrifice in the words of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>’.
